items.title: Newsmax pressures DOJ to block Fox’s $22B Roku deal, Semafor reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Newsmax Inc (NYSE:NMAX) Chief Executive Chris Ruddy is pressing the Justice Department to block Fox Corp's (NASDAQ:FOX) proposed $22 billion acquisition of Roku Inc (NASDAQ:ROKU), leveraging White House access to escalate a regulatory battle against his larger rival.

items.title: Is Disney Stock A Bargain Or Just A Slower Grower?
items.summary: Walt Disney (DIS) has lost about 7% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%. Disney trades at 21.3 times earnings, just under an S&P 500 median of 22.5. The question is whether that is a good business on sale, or a fair price for a slow grower.
